playbook.title: Weekly Invoice Reconciliation
playbook.objective: Match incoming vendor invoices against purchase orders and flag mismatches before payment is approved.

steps.name: Download vendor invoices
steps.trigger: Every Monday 8am, or on ad-hoc request from AP manager
sequence: Download each invoice as PDF into /invoices/{week}
Cross-check count against portal total shown
decisionRules: If portal shows 0 new invoices for a vendor that normally sends 2+/week, flag for manual follow-up
steps.standardOfDone: Every invoice listed in the portal for the date range is downloaded and named consistently; count matches portal total.
vetoes: Never mark this step done if the portal total and downloaded count disagree
failureModes: Portal session times out mid-download, silently skipping remaining invoices (happened 2026-03-11)
Some vendors email invoices instead of posting to the portal, so they get missed
dependencies: Feeds into: Match invoices to purchase orders
steps.tacitLayer: I re-check the portal total against my download count every time, even though that's never been written down anywhere — it's the only way I've caught silent skips.

maturity.nextAction: Add a scripted count-check so the mismatch is flagged automatically instead of relying on me remembering to look.

delegationVerdict.reason: Mechanical download-and-count task with a clear, testable success condition.

steps.evalQuestion: Does the number of PDFs in /invoices/{week}/ exactly equal the portal's displayed invoice count for that date range?

steps.name: Match invoices to purchase orders
steps.trigger: Immediately after invoice download step completes
sequence: Open each invoice and note the PO number
Look up the PO in the ERP system
decisionRules: Mismatches $50-$500: escalate to purchasing manager for review
Mismatches over $500: hold payment entirely, escalate to controller
steps.standardOfDone: Every invoice has a recorded matched/unmatched status and, for mismatches, an escalation owner assigned.
vetoes: Never auto-approve a mismatch over $50, regardless of vendor history
failureModes: PO number handwritten or missing on invoice, causing lookup failures
artifacts: Match-status spreadsheet, one row per invoice, versioned as recon-{week}.xlsx
steps.tacitLayer: For long-standing vendors I trust, I sometimes let a slightly-over-$50 mismatch through if it's clearly a rounding/tax difference — that judgment call has never been written down.

maturity.nextAction: Write down the specific 'clearly a rounding/tax difference' heuristic so it can be codified as a rule instead of relying on tacit judgment.

delegationVerdict.reason: The $ thresholds are automatable, but edge-case judgment on rounding/tax differences still needs a human until that heuristic is made explicit.

steps.evalQuestion: For a batch of test invoices with known mismatches, does the system apply the correct threshold-based routing (auto-approve / escalate / hold) for 100% of them?
